_comment: Dataset catalog: one entry per screen table/chart that can be fed with real data. The web app (web/src/data/datasets.ts) and the API (server/campaign_api/datasets.py) both read this file. Add an entry here, then call useDataset('<name>', DEMO_ROWS) in the screen. Optional scope columns on every dataset: season, state, district, taluka, crop, product, campaign_type.

datasets.name: portfolio.campaigns
datasets.title: Campaign portfolio
datasets.description: One row per active campaign with budget, execution progress, trial-to-adoption, risk and ROI.

columns.name: trial_to_purchase_pct
columns.description: Trial to purchase pct in portfolio.campaigns.

datasets.description: Ranked district × crop opportunities shown on the Opportunity Atlas.

datasets.name: nutrition.triggers
datasets.title: Campaign trigger queue
datasets.source_system: Crop-stage calendar + weather feed + trigger rules
datasets.description: Prioritised campaign triggers. `campaign` is the index of the recommended campaign card (0-2).
